envelope.isEnvelopeOwner.name: IsEnvelopeOwner
envelope.isEnvelopeOwner.summary: True when the profile ID owns the envelope. Ports the js-sdk's isEnvelopeOwner.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile ID to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the profile ID matches the envelope's creator.

envelope.isEnvelopeRecipient.name: IsEnvelopeRecipient
envelope.isEnvelopeRecipient.summary: True when the profile ID is a recipient within the envelope. Ports the js-sdk's isEnvelopeRecipient.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile ID to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when a recipient carries the profile ID.

envelope.canAccessEnvelope.name: CanAccessEnvelope
envelope.canAccessEnvelope.summary: True when the profile ID is the envelope's sender or one of its recipients. Ports the js-sdk's canAccessEnvelope.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile ID to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the profile ID may access the envelope.

envelope.userIsEnvelopeOwner.name: UserIsEnvelopeOwner
envelope.userIsEnvelopeOwner.summary: True when the user's profile owns the envelope. Ports the js-sdk's userIsEnvelopeOwner.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the profile matches the envelope's creator.

envelope.userIsEnvelopeRecipient.name: UserIsEnvelopeRecipient
envelope.userIsEnvelopeRecipient.summary: True when the user's profile is a recipient within the envelope. Ports the js-sdk's userIsEnvelopeRecipient. Matches by profile ID only; recipients matched by email alone do not count.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when a recipient carries the profile's ID.

envelope.envelopeIsActive.name: EnvelopeIsActive
envelope.envelopeIsActive.summary: True when the envelope still has pending actions (not complete, declined, or canceled). Ports the js-sdk's envelopeIsActive.

returns.description: True when the envelope is still active.

envelope.envelopeIsComplete.name: EnvelopeIsComplete
envelope.envelopeIsComplete.summary: True when the envelope's status is anything other than "complete". Ports the js-sdk's envelopeIsComplete, which despite its name returns true for envelopes that are NOT complete; the inverted comparison is kept as-is for parity.

returns.description: True when the envelope is not complete.

envelope.userCanCancelEnvelope.name: UserCanCancelEnvelope
envelope.userCanCancelEnvelope.summary: True when the user owns the envelope and it is still active enough to cancel. Ports the js-sdk's userCanCancelEnvelope.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may cancel the envelope.

envelope.userCanFinishEnvelope.name: UserCanFinishEnvelope
envelope.userCanFinishEnvelope.summary: True when the user owns the envelope and it is still active enough to finish early. Ports the js-sdk's userCanFinishEnvelope.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may finish the envelope.

envelope.recipientHasAction.name: RecipientHasAction
envelope.recipientHasAction.summary: True when the recipient has a pending action. Ports the js-sdk's recipientHasAction. Note this does not necessarily mean the recipient can act yet; see RecipientCanAct.

returns.description: True when the recipient has not yet submitted, declined, or been canceled.

envelope.getRecipientsWithActions.name: GetRecipientsWithActions
envelope.getRecipientsWithActions.summary: The recipients who still have a pending action, in the envelope's stored order. Ports the js-sdk's getRecipientsWithActions. Not all of these recipients may be able to act yet, and a complete, declined, or canceled envelope returns an empty list.

returns.description: The recipients with actions remaining.

envelope.recipientCanAct.name: RecipientCanAct
envelope.recipientCanAct.summary: True when the recipient is next up to act. Ports the js-sdk's recipientCanAct: the recipient acts when it shares a sequence number with the first entry in the pending-actions list.

returns.description: True when the recipient can act now.

envelope.getMyRecipient.name: GetMyRecipient
envelope.getMyRecipient.summary: The envelope recipient matching the session's email, regardless of whether the session is a user or signing session. Ports the js-sdk's getMyRecipient. The email comparison is exact (case-sensitive), matching the js-sdk.

params.name: session
params.description: The current session, or null for no session.

returns.description: The matching recipient, or null when there is none.

envelope.userCanAct.name: UserCanAct
envelope.userCanAct.summary: True when the recipient matching the email (case-insensitive) is next up to act. Ports the js-sdk's userCanAct.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to look for.

returns.description: True when the matching recipient can act now.

envelope.getRecipient.name: GetRecipient
envelope.getRecipient.summary: The envelope recipient matching the email (case-insensitive). Ports the js-sdk's getRecipient.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to look for.

returns.description: The matching recipient, or null when there is none.

envelope.getRecipientWithActions.name: GetRecipientWithActions
envelope.getRecipientWithActions.summary: True when the recipient matching the email (case-insensitive) is next up to act. Ports the js-sdk's getRecipientWithActions, which despite its name returns a flag rather than the recipient; the behavior is kept as-is for parity.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to look for.

returns.description: True when the matching recipient can act now.

envelope.userCanSignNow.name: UserCanSignNow
envelope.userCanSignNow.summary: True when the user can sign now: the envelope is active, the user is one of its recipients, and it is that recipient's turn. Ports the js-sdk's userCanSignNow. The turn lookup matches by profile ID or email, but the recipient membership check matches by profile ID only, so a recipient tied to the user by email alone never passes; the js-sdk behaves the same way.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user can sign now.

envelope.getNextRecipient.name: GetNextRecipient
envelope.getNextRecipient.summary: The next recipient with a pending action, in the envelope's stored order. Ports the js-sdk's getNextRecipient.

returns.description: The next pending recipient, or null when none remain.

envelope.isFieldFilled.name: IsFieldFilled
envelope.isFieldFilled.summary: True when the field has been filled in, per its type's rules: text fields must have a non-blank (and, with a validator set, valid) value, signature/initial/attachment fields must have been acted on, timestamps always count as filled, and grouped radio buttons count when any field in the group is selected. Ports the js-sdk's isFieldFilled (Envelopes/Fields.ts). Unknown field types are never filled.

params.name: allRecipientFields
params.description: Every field assigned to the same recipient, used to resolve grouped fields.

returns.description: True when the field counts as filled.

envelope.isFieldValid.name: IsFieldValid
envelope.isFieldValid.summary: True when the field is valid to submit: optional fields always pass, required fields must be filled. Ports the js-sdk's isFieldValid (Envelopes/Fields.ts).

params.name: allRecipientFields
params.description: Every field assigned to the same recipient, used to resolve grouped fields.

returns.description: True when the field is valid.

envelope.createEnvelope.name: CreateAsync
envelope.createEnvelope.signature: Task<Envelope> CreateAsync(CreateEnvelopeRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.createEnvelope.summary: Creates an envelope, either from a template or directly from documents. Requires a user session. Envelope creation is JSON only on the wire (the deployed handler never reads uploaded file parts), so documents are attached as base64 Data or by Uri.

returns.description: The newly created envelope, with its documents, fields, and recipients.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a recipient failed validation.

envelope.getEnvelope.name: GetAsync
envelope.getEnvelope.signature: Task<Envelope> GetAsync(string envelopeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelope.summary: Gets all metadata for an envelope. Non-creators such as recipients receive only the metadata they are allowed to view.

returns.description: The detailed metadata for the envelope requested.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the envelope was not found.

envelope.getEnvelopes.name: ListAsync
envelope.getEnvelopes.signature: Task<EnvelopeList> ListAsync(ListEnvelopesOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopes.summary: Lists the envelopes accessible to the caller, with optional filters.

returns.description: One page of envelopes plus paging counts.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

envelope.updateEnvelope.name: UpdateAsync
envelope.updateEnvelope.signature: Task<Envelope> UpdateAsync(string envelopeId, UpdateEnvelopeRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.updateEnvelope.summary: Updates an envelope's settings: name, sender identity, reminders, expiration, visibility, contact preferences, and metadata.

params.name: request
params.description: The fields to change; unset fields are left alone.

returns.description: A copy of the updated envelope.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not the creator.

envelope.cancelEnvelope.name: CancelAsync
envelope.cancelEnvelope.signature: Task<Envelope> CancelAsync(string envelopeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.cancelEnvelope.summary: Cancels an envelope. This is permanent: recipients can no longer act on it.

returns.description: The updated envelope. The response omits relations such as recipients, so those properties are null here.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not the creator.

envelope.getEnvelopeDocument.name: GetDocumentAsync
envelope.getEnvelopeDocument.signature: Task<EnvelopeDocument> GetDocumentAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopeDocument.summary: Gets an envelope document's metadata. Accepts a user or signing session; the caller must be the envelope's creator or one of its recipients.

returns.description: The detailed metadata for the document requested.

throws.description: The call failed or the response could not be parsed.

envelope.downloadEnvelopeDocument.name: DownloadDocumentAsync
envelope.downloadEnvelopeDocument.signature: Task<byte[]> DownloadDocumentAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.downloadEnvelopeDocument.summary: Downloads an envelope document's content directly. Accepts a user or signing session. For attachment-type documents this serves the filled variant; for anything else it serves the certificate. Signed variants are generated asynchronously after finalize, so poll the envelope until the certificate document's Signed flag is true before fetching.

returns.description: The raw file bytes.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not a participant.

envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentDownloadLink.name: GetDocumentDownloadLinkAsync
envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentDownloadLink.signature: Task<string> GetDocumentDownloadLinkAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentDownloadLink.summary: Gets a pre-signed download link for an envelope document. The link expires within an hour, so use it immediately and never store or share it. Accepts a user or signing session.

returns.description: The download URL, fetchable without auth headers.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not a participant.

envelope.getCombinedEnvelopeDocumentDown.name: GetCombinedDocumentDownloadLinkAsync
envelope.getCombinedEnvelopeDocumentDown.summary: Gets a pre-signed download link for the single PDF that combines all of an envelope's documents with its completion certificate, in workflow order. Pass the certificate document's ID; the combined PDF shares it. Older envelopes may predate combined PDF generation. The link expires within an hour.

returns.description: The download URL, fetchable without auth headers.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the envelope has no combined PDF.

envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentPreviewLink.name: GetDocumentPreviewLinkAsync
envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentPreviewLink.signature: Task<string> GetDocumentPreviewLinkAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentPreviewLink.summary: Gets a pre-signed preview link for an envelope document (inline content disposition). The link expires within an hour, so use it immediately and never store or share it. Accepts a user or signing session.

returns.description: The preview URL, fetchable without auth headers.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not a participant.

envelope.getEnvelopeFile.name: GetFileAsync
envelope.getEnvelopeFile.signature: Task<byte[]> GetFileAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopeFile.summary: Downloads a file attached to an envelope. Kept for parity with the js-sdk's deprecated getEnvelopeFile; it fetches the same bytes as DownloadDocumentAsync.

returns.description: The raw file bytes.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not a participant.

envelope.updateEnvelopeField.name: UpdateFieldAsync
envelope.updateEnvelopeField.signature: Task<EnvelopeField> UpdateFieldAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, string fieldName, string value, bool prepared = False, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.updateEnvelopeField.summary: Updates an envelope field's value, typically as a recipient fills in fields while signing. Accepts a user or signing session valid for the field's role. For signature and initial fields, pass the ID of a stored signature or initials block. Checkboxes and radio buttons take the strings "true"/"false" (the server deliberately does not coerce booleans). Attachment fields are updated with UploadFieldAttachmentAsync instead, and timestamp and payment fields reject direct writes.

params.name: roleName
params.description: The role the field is assigned to.

params.name: fieldName
params.description: The name of the field to update.

params.name: prepared
params.description: True when the sender is pre-filling the field before sending.

returns.description: A copy of the updated field.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the value failed validation.

envelope.uploadEnvelopeFieldAttachment.name: UploadFieldAttachmentAsync
envelope.uploadEnvelopeFieldAttachment.signature: Task<EnvelopeField> UploadFieldAttachmentAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, string fieldName, Stream content, string fileName, string? contentType = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.uploadEnvelopeFieldAttachment.summary: Uploads a file to an attachment field. Accepts a user or signing session valid for the field's role. Any content type is accepted (files are virus-scanned server-side), but set accurately because the server trusts the declared type. Large uploads can outlast short endpoint timeouts; the js-sdk allows two minutes.

params.name: roleName
params.description: The role the field is assigned to.

params.name: fieldName
params.description: The name of the attachment field.

params.name: fileName
params.description: The filename to store with the attachment.

params.name: contentType
params.description: The file's MIME type. Defaults to application/octet-stream.

returns.description: A copy of the updated field.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the file failed the virus scan.

envelope.deleteEnvelopeFieldAttachment.name: DeleteFieldAttachmentAsync
envelope.deleteEnvelopeFieldAttachment.signature: Task<EnvelopeField> DeleteFieldAttachmentAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, string fieldName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.deleteEnvelopeFieldAttachment.summary: Removes the file from an attachment field. This is a PUT rather than a DELETE because the field itself survives; omitting the file part is what signals the server to clear the current attachment. Accepts a user or signing session valid for the field's role.

params.name: roleName
params.description: The role the field is assigned to.

params.name: fieldName
params.description: The name of the attachment field.

returns.description: A copy of the updated field.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the field is not an attachment field.

envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentPageDisplayU.name: GetDocumentPageDisplayUriAsync
envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentPageDisplayU.signature: Task<string> GetDocumentPageDisplayUriAsync(string documentId, int page, string variant = original, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopeDocumentPageDisplayU.summary: Gets a display URI for one page of an envelope document. Pages are rendered server-side into PNGs suitable for IMG tags; they are for display only, are not legally binding, and contain no participant metadata. The URI is signed with a short expiration, so use it immediately and never store or cache it. Accepts a user or signing session, and a signing session is blocked until the recipient completes their auth methods. The server also accepts the literal page "thumb" for a thumbnail, which this method (like the js-sdk) does not expose.

returns.description: The page display URI.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because auth steps are incomplete.

envelope.getEnvelopesZip.name: GetZipAsync
envelope.getEnvelopesZip.signature: Task<byte[]> GetZipAsync(IEnumerable<string> envelopeIds, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
envelope.getEnvelopesZip.summary: Generates a ZIP file containing all data for the specified envelopes: filled PDFs, the certificate, the combined PDF when present, and signer attachments under an attachments/ folder. The caller must be each envelope's owner or one of its recipients. The archive arrives as application/octet-stream. Large envelopes take a while to assemble, so configure the endpoint timeout accordingly (the js-sdk allows two minutes).

returns.description: The raw ZIP bytes.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not a participant of every envelope.

envelope.sortFields.name: SortFields
envelope.sortFields.summary: Sorts fields in reading order: by page, then by Y coordinate in 5-unit bands (Y origin is the bottom-left corner, so bands sort descending), then by X coordinate. Sorts the list in place and returns it, like the js-sdk's sortFields. Local logic; no API call.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to sort. Modified in place.

returns.description: The same list, sorted.

envelope.sortDocuments.name: SortDocuments
envelope.sortDocuments.summary: Sorts documents by their order, falling back to creation date. Sorts the list in place and returns it, like the js-sdk's sortDocuments. Local logic; no API call.

params.name: documents
params.description: The documents to sort. Modified in place.

returns.description: The same list, sorted.

envelope.sortRecipients.name: SortRecipients
envelope.sortRecipients.summary: Sorts recipients by sequence, then by order within the sequence. Sorts the list in place and returns it, like the js-sdk's sortRecipients; a null list passes through. Local logic; no API call.

params.name: recipients
params.description: The recipients to sort. Modified in place.

returns.description: The same list, sorted, or null if null was passed.

permission.userHasPermissions.name: UserHasPermissions
permission.userHasPermissions.summary: True when the profile has every one of the specified permissions, whether granted directly, by a role, or through a group. Ports the js-sdk's userHasPermissions (Sessions/Permissions.ts). An empty permission list always passes.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session (always fails a non-empty check).

params.name: permissions
params.description: The permissions that must all be present.

returns.description: True when every requested permission is held.

template.userIsTemplateCreator.name: UserIsTemplateCreator
template.userIsTemplateCreator.summary: True when the user created the template. Ports the js-sdk's userIsTemplateCreator.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

params.name: template
params.description: The template to check against, or null.

returns.description: True when the profile matches the template's creator.

template.userHasSharedTemplate.name: UserHasSharedTemplate
template.userHasSharedTemplate.summary: True when the template is shared with the user: it is not personal and belongs to the user's organization. Ports the js-sdk's userHasSharedTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

params.name: template
params.description: The template to check against, or null.

returns.description: True when the template is shared with the profile's organization.

template.userCanCreatePersonalTemplate.name: UserCanCreatePersonalTemplate
template.userCanCreatePersonalTemplate.summary: True when the user can create a personal (private) template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanCreatePersonalTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user holds the personal-create permission.

template.userCanCreateOrgTemplate.name: UserCanCreateOrgTemplate
template.userCanCreateOrgTemplate.summary: True when the user can create an org-shared template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanCreateOrgTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user holds the org-create permission.

template.userCanCreatePublicTemplate.name: UserCanCreatePublicTemplate
template.userCanCreatePublicTemplate.summary: True when the user can create a public template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanCreatePublicTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user holds the public-create permission.

template.userCanReadTemplate.name: UserCanReadTemplate
template.userCanReadTemplate.summary: True when the user can read/view the template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanReadTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may view the template.

template.userCanUpdateTemplate.name: UserCanUpdateTemplate
template.userCanUpdateTemplate.summary: True when the user can update the template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanUpdateTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may modify the template.

template.userCanMakeTemplatePrivate.name: UserCanMakeTemplatePrivate
template.userCanMakeTemplatePrivate.summary: True when the user can make the template personal (private). Ports the js-sdk's userCanMakeTemplatePrivate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may change the template's visibility to private.

template.userCanMakeTemplateShared.name: UserCanMakeTemplateShared
template.userCanMakeTemplateShared.summary: True when the user can make the template org-shared. Ports the js-sdk's userCanMakeTemplateShared.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may change the template's visibility to shared.

template.userCanMakeTemplatePublic.name: UserCanMakeTemplatePublic
template.userCanMakeTemplatePublic.summary: True when the user can make the template public. Ports the js-sdk's userCanMakeTemplatePublic.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may change the template's visibility to public.

template.userCanChangeOrgVisibility.name: UserCanChangeOrgVisibility
template.userCanChangeOrgVisibility.summary: True when the user, as the template's creator, can change whether it is personal vs org-shared. Ports the js-sdk's userCanChangeOrgVisibility.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may change the template's organization visibility.

template.userCanDeleteTemplate.name: UserCanDeleteTemplate
template.userCanDeleteTemplate.summary: True when the user can delete the template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanDeleteTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may delete the template.

template.userCanSendTemplate.name: UserCanSendTemplate
template.userCanSendTemplate.summary: True when the user can create an envelope from the template. Ports the js-sdk's userCanSendTemplate. Private templates are sendable by their creator, shared templates by anyone in the owning organization, and public templates by anyone; a template whose visibility is missing or unrecognized is never sendable (the js-sdk's tail checks on roles and fields can only return a falsy result, and that is kept for parity).

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may send the template.

template.userCanCreateTemplate.name: UserCanCreateTemplate
template.userCanCreateTemplate.summary: True when the user can create a new template of any visibility. Ports the js-sdk's userCanCreateTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user holds any of the template-create permissions.

template.userCanBuildTemplate.name: UserCanBuildTemplate
template.userCanBuildTemplate.summary: True when the user can "build" the template (use the field builder): the user must have write access and the template must have at least one signer role. Ports the js-sdk's userCanBuildTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may open the template in the builder.

template.getFieldsForRole.name: GetFieldsForRole
template.getFieldsForRole.summary: The template's fields assigned to the named role. Ports the js-sdk's getFieldsForRole.

params.name: roleName
params.description: The role name to filter by.

returns.description: The fields assigned to the role.

template.userCanPreviewTemplate.name: UserCanPreviewTemplate
template.userCanPreviewTemplate.summary: True when the user can preview the template: the user must have read access, the template must have at least one signer, and every signer must have at least one field. Ports the js-sdk's userCanPreviewTemplate.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

returns.description: True when the user may preview the template.

template.canPerformTemplateAction.name: CanPerformTemplateAction
template.canPerformTemplateAction.signature: ValueTuple<bool, string> CanPerformTemplateAction(Profile? profile, string action, Template? template = null)
template.canPerformTemplateAction.summary: Whether the user can perform the given action on a template, with a message explaining any denial. Ports the js-sdk's canPerformTemplateAction (Templates/Actions.ts). The template may be omitted only for the create actions. Note this checks the profile's directly assigned permissions only (via HasRequiredPermissions), not role- or group-conferred ones, matching the js-sdk.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

params.name: action
params.description: The action to test; see TemplateAction for known values.

params.name: template
params.description: The template to act on, required for everything except the create actions.

returns.description: CanPerform, plus a Message explaining the denial (empty when allowed).

template.hasRequiredPermissions.name: HasRequiredPermissions
template.hasRequiredPermissions.summary: True when the profile's directly assigned permissions include every one of the specified permissions. Ports the js-sdk's hasRequiredPermissions (Templates/Actions.ts). Unlike UserHasPermissions, this ignores role- and group-conferred permissions, matching the js-sdk. An empty permission list always passes.

params.name: profile
params.description: The profile to check, or null for no session.

params.name: permissions
params.description: The permissions that must all be present.

returns.description: True when every requested permission is directly held.

template.getTemplates.name: ListAsync
template.getTemplates.signature: Task<TemplateList> ListAsync(GetTemplatesOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
template.getTemplates.summary: Gets the templates accessible to the caller, with optional filters.

returns.description: One page of templates plus paging counts.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

template.getTemplate.name: GetAsync
template.getTemplate.signature: Task<Template> GetAsync(string templateId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
template.getTemplate.summary: Gets one template by its ID. The caller must have at least view access to it. The detail response includes the template's roles, documents, and fields, which the list response omits.

returns.description: The requested template.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the template was not found.

template.createTemplate.name: CreateAsync
template.createTemplate.signature: Task<Template> CreateAsync(CreateTemplateRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
template.createTemplate.summary: Creates a template, sending the request as JSON. Documents may be attached by URI or Base64 data via Documents; to upload local files directly, use the overload that takes TemplateFileUpload parts. Roles are created inline when supplied. Fields cannot be created here (the server validates a create-time fields array but discards it); add them afterward through CreateAsync.

returns.description: The new template, including its documents, roles, and fields.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a document was an unsupported type.

template.updateTemplate.name: UpdateAsync
template.updateTemplate.signature: Task<Template> UpdateAsync(string templateId, UpdateTemplateRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
template.updateTemplate.summary: Updates a template's settings. Reminder settings are rewritten on every update; see UpdateTemplateRequest for the details.

returns.description: The updated template.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller may not edit the template.

template.deleteTemplate.name: DeleteAsync
template.deleteTemplate.signature: Task DeleteAsync(string templateId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

returns.description: A task that completes when the template has been deleted.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller may not edit the template.

template.duplicateTemplate.name: DuplicateAsync
template.duplicateTemplate.signature: Task<Template> DuplicateAsync(string templateId, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
template.duplicateTemplate.summary: Duplicates a template as a complete clone: settings (reminders included), documents, roles, and fields.

returns.description: The new copy.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the template was not found.

template.createTemplateFromSharepoint.name: CreateFromSharepointAsync
template.createTemplateFromSharepoint.summary: Creates a template from a Sharepoint file. Dead on the deployed API: no handler exists for this route, so every call fails. Ported to match the js-sdk surface; retirement is pending.

params.name: request
params.description: The Sharepoint source and template name.

returns.description: The new template, if the API ever serves this route.

throws.description: Always thrown today; the deployed API has no handler for this call.

template.toggleTemplateStar.name: ToggleStarAsync

params.name: templateId

validator.isValidEmail.name: IsValidEmail

validator.isValidPhone.name: IsValidPhone
validator.isValidPhone.summary: True when the value contains a plausible phone number. Ports the js-sdk's isValidPhone (Templates/Validators.ts). Null and empty values fail.

params.name: phone
params.description: The value to check, or null.

returns.description: True when the value contains a valid phone number.

validator.isValidRoleName.name: IsValidRoleName
validator.isValidRoleName.summary: True when the value names one of the given template roles. Ports the js-sdk's isValidRoleName (Templates/Validators.ts).

validator.isValidTag.name: IsValidTag
validator.isValidTag.summary: True when the value is an acceptable tag: up to 32 letters, digits, or hyphens, or an exact match for an existing tag. Ports the js-sdk's isValidTag (Templates/Validators.ts), including its quirk that the empty string passes.

returns.description: True when the tag is acceptable.

apiKey.getApiKeys.name: ListAsync
apiKey.getApiKeys.summary: Gets the API keys for the caller's organization, each with its acting profile. Secrets are never included in listings; they are returned only by CreateAsync and RotateAsync.

returns.description: The organization's API keys, without secrets.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

apiKey.createApiKey.name: CreateAsync
apiKey.createApiKey.signature: Task<ApiKey> CreateAsync(CreateApiKeyRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apiKey.createApiKey.summary: Creates an API key acting as the given profile. Store the returned secret safely: this response and RotateAsync are the only places it appears.

returns.description: The new key, including its secret.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the profile is not in the caller's organization.

apiKey.rotateApiKey.name: RotateAsync
apiKey.rotateApiKey.signature: Task<ApiKey> RotateAsync(string clientId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apiKey.rotateApiKey.summary: Rotates an API key's secret. Existing sessions issued from the key stay valid, so rotation is safe to do at any time.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The client ID of the key to rotate.

returns.description: The key with its new secret.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the key was not found.

apiKey.updateApiKey.name: UpdateAsync
apiKey.updateApiKey.signature: Task<ApiKey> UpdateAsync(string clientId, UpdateApiKeyRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apiKey.updateApiKey.summary: Updates an API key's name, acting profile, or admin flag. Only the fields set on the request are sent; fields omitted are left unchanged.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The client ID of the key to update.

returns.description: The updated key, without its secret.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the key was not found.

apiKey.deleteApiKey.name: DeleteAsync
apiKey.deleteApiKey.signature: Task DeleteAsync(string clientId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apiKey.deleteApiKey.summary: Deletes an API key. Sessions already issued from the key remain valid until they expire, but no new sessions can be created with it.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The client ID of the key to delete.

returns.description: A task that completes when the key is deleted.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

auth.authenticate.name: AuthenticateAsync
auth.authenticate.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> AuthenticateAsync(AuthenticateRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.authenticate.summary: Authenticates to Verdocs with a username and password (the OAuth2 password grant) and returns the session tokens. Call SetToken with the access token to apply it to the endpoint.

params.name: request
params.description: The credentials to authenticate with, one of the grant-specific subtypes.

returns.description: Authentication tokens and expiration details.

throws.description: The API rejected the credentials or the call failed.

auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.name: GetOAuth2AuthorizeUrl
auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.signature: string GetOAuth2AuthorizeUrl(string clientId, string redirectUri, string? state = null, string? scope = null)
auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.summary: Builds the URL that starts an OAuth2 authorization code flow. Send the user's browser there; after they authenticate and authorize, they are redirected to with a code query parameter that a server-side integration exchanges for tokens. This builds the URL locally and makes no network call, which is why it is synchronous.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The client ID of the registered OAuth2 application.

params.name: redirectUri
params.description: Where to send the user after authorization. Must match a redirect URI registered for the application.

params.name: state
params.description: Opaque value returned unchanged in the redirect, used to prevent CSRF attacks.

returns.description: The authorization URL to redirect the user to.

auth.refreshToken.name: RefreshTokenAsync
auth.refreshToken.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> RefreshTokenAsync(string refreshToken, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.refreshToken.summary: Exchanges a refresh token for fresh session tokens. Call before the current session expires. The endpoint does not apply the result automatically; pass the new access token to SetToken, matching AuthenticateAsync.

params.name: refreshToken
params.description: The refresh token from an earlier authentication response.

returns.description: Fresh authentication tokens and expiration details.

throws.description: The API rejected the refresh token or the call failed.

auth.changePassword.name: ChangePasswordAsync
auth.changePassword.signature: Task<ChangePasswordResponse> ChangePasswordAsync(ChangePasswordRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.changePassword.summary: Changes the caller's password when the old password is known (typically for logged-in users). Wrong old passwords surface as a VerdocsApiException.

returns.description: The change status; "OK" on success.

throws.description: The API rejected the change or the call failed.

auth.resetPassword.name: ResetPasswordAsync
auth.resetPassword.signature: Task<ResetPasswordResponse> ResetPasswordAsync(ResetPasswordRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.resetPassword.summary: Requests or completes a password reset, for when the old password is not known (typically in login forms). Send only the email first to have a reset code delivered, then send the email plus the code and the new password to complete the reset.

params.name: request
params.description: The reset parameters; see ResetPasswordRequest for the two-step flow.

returns.description: The reset status; "OK" on success.

throws.description: The API rejected the reset (for example, a bad code) or the call failed.

auth.resendVerification.name: ResendVerificationAsync
auth.resendVerification.summary: Resends the email-verification message for the current session's user. Intended for the post-signup state where the caller holds a session but is not yet verified: apply the access token returned by CreateAsync with SetToken, then call this if the original message was lost or its code expired.

returns.description: A task that completes when the message has been queued.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

auth.verifyEmail.name: VerifyEmailAsync
auth.verifyEmail.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> VerifyEmailAsync(VerifyEmailRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.verifyEmail.summary: Completes email verification with the code the user received. This call requires the partial session issued at signup: apply the access token returned by CreateAsync with SetToken before calling. (The js-sdk documents this endpoint as usable while unauthenticated; the deployed API rejects that.) Success returns fresh, fully verified session tokens; apply the new access token with SetToken.

params.name: request
params.description: The email address and the emailed verification code.

returns.description: Fresh authentication tokens for the now-verified session.

throws.description: The code was wrong or expired, the session was missing, or the call failed.

returns.description: The caller's user record.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

brand.createBrand.signature: Task<Brand> CreateAsync(string organizationId, CreateBrandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

brand.getBrand.signature: Task<Brand> GetAsync(string organizationId, string brandId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
brand.getBrand.summary: Gets one brand by its ID.

brand.updateBrand.name: UpdateAsync

brand.updateBrand.summary: Updates a brand. Only the fields set on the request are sent; fields omitted are left unchanged.

returns.description: The updated brand.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the brand was not found.

brand.updateBrandLogo.name: UpdateLogoAsync
brand.updateBrandLogo.signature: Task<Brand> UpdateLogoAsync(string organizationId, string brandId, Stream file, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
brand.updateBrandLogo.summary: Uploads a new full-size logo for the brand, setting its full logo URL. The stream is read once and disposed with the request.

brand.updateBrandThumbnail.signature: Task<Brand> UpdateThumbnailAsync(string organizationId, string brandId, Stream file, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
brand.updateBrandThumbnail.summary: Uploads a new thumbnail for the brand, setting its thumbnail URL. The stream is read once and disposed with the request.

params.description: File name to declare for the upload, for example "thumbnail.png".

params.description: MIME type to declare for the upload, for example "image/png".

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the brand is the default.

brand.addBrandEmailDomain.name: AddEmailDomainAsync
brand.addBrandEmailDomain.signature: Task<Brand> AddEmailDomainAsync(string organizationId, string brandId, AddBrandEmailDomainRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
brand.addBrandEmailDomain.summary: Adds a custom email domain to a brand. The response carries the DNS records to publish (DKIM tokens and status flags); verify them with VerifyEmailDomainAsync once published.

params.name: request
params.description: The domain and sender address details.

returns.description: The updated brand with its email domain configuration.

brand.removeBrandEmailDomain.summary: Removes a brand's custom email domain. Branded email reverts to the Verdocs sender.

returns.description: The updated brand with the email domain removed.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the brand was not found.

brand.verifyBrandEmailDomain.summary: Triggers verification of a brand's email domain DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

returns.description: The updated brand with its current verification status.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because no email domain is configured.

contact.getOrganizationContacts.name: ListAsync
contact.getOrganizationContacts.summary: Gets the contacts in the caller's organization, sorted by name.

contact.createOrganizationContact.name: CreateAsync
contact.createOrganizationContact.signature: Task<Profile> CreateAsync(CreateContactRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
contact.createOrganizationContact.summary: Creates a contact in the caller's organization. The caller must be an admin.

returns.description: A task that completes when the contact is deleted.

group.getGroups.summary: Gets the groups in the caller's organization, without their membership lists; call GetAsync for a group's members.

group.getGroup.signature: Task<Group> GetAsync(string groupId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
group.getGroup.summary: Gets one group with its permissions and membership entries.

returns.description: The requested group.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the group was not found.

group.createGroup.name: CreateAsync
group.createGroup.signature: Task<Group> CreateAsync(CreateGroupRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
group.createGroup.summary: Creates a group. The caller must be an admin; "everyone" is a reserved name.

params.name: request
params.description: The new group's name and permissions.

returns.description: The new group.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the name is reserved.

group.updateGroup.signature: Task<Group> UpdateAsync(string groupId, UpdateGroupRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
group.updateGroup.summary: Updates a group's name and permissions. The caller must be an admin. Both fields are required and the permissions list replaces the previous one.

returns.description: The updated group.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the group is "everyone".

group.deleteGroup.name: DeleteAsync
group.deleteGroup.signature: Task DeleteAsync(string groupId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
group.deleteGroup.summary: Deletes a group and its membership entries. The caller must be an admin; the "everyone" group cannot be deleted.

returns.description: A task that completes when the group is deleted.

group.deleteGroupMember.summary: Removes a member from a group. The caller must be an admin.

returns.description: A task that completes when the membership is removed.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the membership was not found.

initial.createInitials.name: CreateAsync

params.description: The filename to store with the image.

returns.description: The newly created initials block.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

invitation.getOrganizationInvitations.name: ListAsync
invitation.getOrganizationInvitations.summary: Gets the invitations pending for the caller's organization, sorted by email.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

invitation.updateOrganizationInvitation.summary: Updates a pending invitation's role. The email cannot be changed; delete and re-create the invitation instead. invitation.getOrganizationInvitation.summary: Gets an invitation's details, typically as the first step of accepting it. returns.description: The invitation, with its organization.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the token is invalid.

invitation.acceptOrganizationInvitation.name: AcceptAsync
invitation.acceptOrganizationInvitation.summary: Accepts an invitation. Creates a user for the invitee when needed, creates a profile with the invited role and makes it current, and returns session tokens for it; apply them with SetToken.

returns.description: Session tokens for the new profile.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the invitation was declined.

invitation.declineOrganizationInvitation.name: DeclineAsync

invitation.declineOrganizationInvitation.summary: Declines an invitation. The status becomes "declined", which shows the organization's admins the invite was refused, blocks further invitations to the email, and stops reminder emails.

params.name: token
params.description: The invite token from the invitation email.

returns.description: A task that completes when the invitation is declined.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the token is invalid.
