returns.description: The new notification template.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a template already exists for the event.

notification.updateNotificationTemplate.name: UpdateAsync
notification.updateNotificationTemplate.signature: Task<NotificationTemplate> UpdateAsync(string templateId, UpdateNotificationTemplateRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
notification.updateNotificationTemplate.summary: Updates a notification template's message bodies. The server validates that the bodies include the event's required variables, and may attach non-blocking warnings and an HTML quality score, which arrive in the result's AdditionalData.

returns.description: The updated notification template.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a required variable is missing.

notification.deleteNotificationTemplate.name: DeleteAsync
notification.deleteNotificationTemplate.signature: Task DeleteAsync(string templateId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
notification.deleteNotificationTemplate.summary: Deletes a notification template. The event reverts to the platform's default message.

returns.description: A task that completes when the template is deleted.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

notification.getNotifications.name: GetNotificationsAsync
notification.getNotifications.summary: Gets the caller's most recent in-app notifications. The API returns at most 20.

returns.description: The raw JSON array of notification rows.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

organization.getOrganization.name: GetAsync
organization.getOrganization.signature: Task<Organization> GetAsync(string organizationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.getOrganization.summary: Gets one organization by its ID. The caller must be a member of it; the response includes the organization's entitlements, children, and parent.

returns.description: The requested organization.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not a member.

organization.getOrganizationChildren.name: GetChildrenAsync
organization.getOrganizationChildren.signature: Task<IReadOnlyList<Organization>> GetChildrenAsync(string organizationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.getOrganizationChildren.summary: Gets an organization's child organizations, each with its entitlements. The caller must be an admin of the parent. The server answers 404 when the organization has no children, so expect an exception rather than an empty list for a childless parent.

returns.description: The child organizations.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because there are no children.

organization.getOrganizationUsage.name: GetUsageAsync
organization.getOrganizationUsage.signature: Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, long>>> GetUsageAsync(string organizationId, GetOrganizationUsageOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.getOrganizationUsage.summary: Gets an organization's usage counters, including its children's when it is a parent. The caller must be an admin. The result is keyed by organization ID, and each entry maps a usage type (see UsageType) to its count for the period.

params.name: options
params.description: Optional date range and usage-type filters.

returns.description: Usage counts grouped by organization ID, then usage type.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

organization.createOrganization.name: CreateAsync
organization.createOrganization.signature: Task<CreateOrganizationResponse> CreateAsync(CreateOrganizationRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.createOrganization.summary: Creates an organization. For a top-level organization the caller becomes its owner, is switched to the new profile, and receives fresh session tokens; apply them with SetToken. When ParentId is set (and matches the caller's current organization), a child organization is created instead: the caller's session is left alone and the child arrives with an auto-created default API key.

returns.description: The new organization, plus session tokens for top-level creations.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the parent ID is not the caller's organization.

examples.code:
var created = await endpoint.Organizations.CreateAsync(new CreateOrganizationRequest { Name = "NewOrg" });
endpoint.SetToken(created.AccessToken);

organization.updateOrganization.name: UpdateAsync
organization.updateOrganization.signature: Task<Organization> UpdateAsync(string organizationId, UpdateOrganizationRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.updateOrganization.summary: Updates an organization. The caller must be an admin. Only the fields set on the request are sent; fields omitted are left unchanged.

returns.description: The updated organization, including its groups and entitlements.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

organization.getOrganizationPipelineSett.name: GetPipelineSettingsAsync
organization.getOrganizationPipelineSett.signature: Task<PipelineSettings> GetPipelineSettingsAsync(string organizationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.getOrganizationPipelineSett.summary: Gets an organization's document-pipeline settings. The caller must be an admin.

returns.description: The pipeline settings, with every flag normalized to a boolean.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

organization.updateOrganizationPipelineS.name: UpdatePipelineSettingsAsync
organization.updateOrganizationPipelineS.signature: Task<PipelineSettings> UpdatePipelineSettingsAsync(string organizationId, UpdatePipelineSettingsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.updateOrganizationPipelineS.summary: Updates an organization's document-pipeline settings. The caller must be an admin. Only the flags set on the request are sent; flags omitted are left unchanged.

returns.description: The updated pipeline settings, with every flag normalized to a boolean.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

organization.deleteOrganization.name: DeleteAsync
organization.deleteOrganization.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> DeleteAsync(string organizationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.deleteOrganization.summary: Deletes the caller's current organization. The caller must be an owner, the ID must match the caller's current organization, and deletion protection must be off. Document files are retained in storage even though the database records are removed.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: The organization's unique ID, as a safety check.

returns.description:
Session tokens for the caller's next remaining profile, or null when no profile
            remains and the caller is signed out.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because deletion protection is on.

organization.updateOrganizationLogo.name: UpdateLogoAsync
organization.updateOrganizationLogo.signature: Task<Organization> UpdateLogoAsync(string organizationId, Stream file, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.updateOrganizationLogo.summary: Uploads a new full-size logo for the organization. The caller must be an admin. The stream is read once and disposed with the request. Large uploads may need a longer endpoint timeout than the 60-second default.

params.name: fileName
params.description: File name to declare for the upload, for example "logo.png".

params.name: contentType
params.description: MIME type to declare for the upload, for example "image/png".

returns.description: The updated organization, including its groups and entitlements.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

organization.updateOrganizationThumbnail.name: UpdateThumbnailAsync
organization.updateOrganizationThumbnail.signature: Task<Organization> UpdateThumbnailAsync(string organizationId, Stream file, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
organization.updateOrganizationThumbnail.summary: Uploads a new thumbnail logo for the organization. The caller must be an admin. The stream is read once and disposed with the request.

params.name: file
params.description: The image content. A square image is recommended.

params.name: fileName
params.description: File name to declare for the upload, for example "thumbnail.png".

params.name: contentType
params.description: MIME type to declare for the upload, for example "image/png".

returns.description: The updated organization, including its groups and entitlements.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not an admin.

organization.getEntitlements.name: GetEntitlementsAsync
organization.getEntitlements.summary: Gets the entitlements granted to the caller's organization. The list may include entries that are not yet active or have expired; see GetActiveEntitlementsAsync for the collapsed current view.

returns.description: All entitlement grants for the caller's organization.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

organization.getActiveEntitlements.name: GetActiveEntitlementsAsync
organization.getActiveEntitlements.summary: Gets the caller's organization entitlements collapsed to the currently active grant per feature, keyed by feature name (see EntitlementFeature). Presence of a key means the feature is enabled now; the entry carries its limits and dates.

returns.description: The active entitlement per feature.

throws.description: The endpoint has no active session.
The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

profile.getProfiles.name: ListAsync
profile.getProfiles.summary: Gets the caller's profiles. A user has one profile per organization membership; exactly one is marked Current at a time and operations are performed as that profile.

returns.description: The caller's profiles.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

profile.getCurrentProfile.name: GetCurrentAsync
profile.getCurrentProfile.summary: Gets the caller's current profile. A user has one profile per organization membership and exactly one is current at a time; operations are performed as that profile.

returns.description: The profile marked current, or null if the caller has none.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

profile.createProfile.name: CreateAsync
profile.createProfile.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> CreateAsync(CreateProfileRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
profile.createProfile.summary: Registers a new user account plus a new organization the caller will own. Call this on an unauthenticated endpoint: the deployed API rejects the request when a session is present (users join existing organizations by invitation instead). The new profile becomes the user's current profile and session tokens are returned, but the email is not verified yet, so most other calls will fail until the user submits the emailed code via VerifyEmailAsync.

returns.description: Session tokens for the new (not yet verified) profile.

throws.description: The email is already registered, the caller was authenticated, or the call failed.

profile.switchProfile.name: SwitchAsync
profile.switchProfile.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> SwitchAsync(string profileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
profile.switchProfile.summary: Switches the caller's current profile and returns fresh session tokens for it. The current profile drives permission checks and record ownership for most operations, so select the appropriate profile before making other calls. The endpoint does not apply the new tokens automatically; pass the access token to SetToken, matching AuthenticateAsync.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile to make current. Must belong to the caller.

returns.description: Fresh session tokens for the newly current profile.

throws.description: The profile was not found or the call failed.

profile.updateProfile.name: UpdateAsync
profile.updateProfile.signature: Task<Profile> UpdateAsync(string profileId, UpdateProfileRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
profile.updateProfile.summary: Updates a profile: the caller's own current profile, or, for admins, another member of the same organization. The two paths accept different fields; see UpdateProfileRequest.

params.name: request
params.description: The fields to change. Unset properties are left as they are.

returns.description: The updated profile.

throws.description: The profile was not found, a field was not accepted, or the call failed.

profile.deleteProfile.name: DeleteAsync
profile.deleteProfile.signature: Task<DeleteProfileResponse> DeleteAsync(string profileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
profile.deleteProfile.summary: Deletes one of the caller's profiles. Deleting the current profile switches the caller to the next available one and returns fresh tokens for it; deleting the last profile logs the caller out and returns a status message instead (see DeleteProfileResponse). Deleting a profile that is NOT current performs the delete but the deployed API sends no response at all, so the call ends in a TimeoutException. Until that is fixed server-side, the workaround is to SwitchAsync to the profile first and then delete it.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile to delete. Must belong to the caller.

returns.description: Tokens for the next profile, or a logout notice when it was the last one.

throws.description: The profile was not found or the call failed.

profile.updateProfilePhoto.name: UpdatePhotoAsync
profile.updateProfilePhoto.signature: Task<Profile> UpdatePhotoAsync(string profileId, Stream photo, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
profile.updateProfilePhoto.summary: Replaces the profile photo. Only the caller's own current profile accepts a photo. The stream is read to the end and disposed when the request completes.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile to update. Must be the caller's current profile.

params.name: fileName
params.description: Filename to report for the upload, for example "avatar.png".

params.name: contentType
params.description: MIME type of the image, for example "image/png". The server stores and serves the declared type without validating it.

returns.description: The updated profile; Picture carries the new photo URL.

throws.description: The upload was rejected or the call failed.

recipient.envelopeRecipientAgree.name: AgreeAsync
recipient.envelopeRecipientAgree.signature: Task<Recipient> AgreeAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, string? disclosures = null, RecipientDisclosureAgreeBody? data = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.envelopeRecipientAgree.summary: Agrees to the electronic signing disclosures. Requires a signing session, and must happen before the recipient completes fields or submits.

params.name: disclosures
params.description: The disclosure text shown to the recipient, recorded with the agreement. Default is what Verdocs shows when the organization supplies no override.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional locale details to record with the agreement.

returns.description: The updated recipient.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is not a signing session.

recipient.envelopeRecipientDecline.name: DeclineAsync
recipient.envelopeRecipientDecline.signature: Task<Recipient> DeclineAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.envelopeRecipientDecline.summary: Declines to sign. If any recipient declines, the entire envelope becomes non-viable and later recipients may no longer act; the creator is notified when this happens. Requires a signing session.

returns.description: The updated recipient.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is not a signing session.

recipient.envelopeRecipientSubmit.name: SubmitAsync
recipient.envelopeRecipientSubmit.signature: Task<Recipient> SubmitAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, RecipientSubmitBody? data = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.envelopeRecipientSubmit.summary: Submits the envelope: the recipient's signing is finished. Every field must be valid and complete for this to succeed. Requires a signing session.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional locale details to record with the submission.

returns.description: The updated recipient.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a required field is incomplete.

recipient.startSigningSession.name: StartSigningSessionAsync
recipient.startSigningSession.signature: Task<SignerTokenResponse> StartSigningSessionAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.startSigningSession.summary: Begins a signing session for an envelope using an access key from an email or SMS invite, or the access key returned by GetInPersonLinkAsync. No prior session is required. On success the signing token is stored on this endpoint (the js-sdk does the same), so call this on a dedicated endpoint instance to avoid replacing an active user session.

params.name: key
params.description: Access key generated by the envelope creator or an email/SMS invite.

returns.description: The signing session token plus envelope and recipient metadata.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the key is invalid or already used.

recipient.getInPersonLink.name: GetInPersonLinkAsync
recipient.getInPersonLink.signature: Task<InPersonLinkResponse> GetInPersonLinkAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.getInPersonLink.summary: Gets an in-person signing link. Must be called by the envelope's owner/creator under a user session. The response also carries the raw access key (usable later with StartSigningSessionAsync) and an access token for immediate signing in embeds. In-person signing is a lower-security operation than authenticated signing and the final envelope certificate reflects this.

returns.description: The signing link, key, token, and envelope/recipient metadata.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not the creator.

recipient.verifySigner.name: VerifySignerAsync
recipient.verifySigner.summary: Completes one verification step for the current signing session. Recipients with auth methods attached must agree to the disclosures first, then complete every step before viewing documents, completing fields, or submitting. Requires a signing session. This is also where real knowledge-based authentication runs; the endpoint's Kba resource targets legacy /v2/kba routes that were never deployed.

returns.description: The updated signing session.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the code was wrong.

recipient.delegateRecipient.name: DelegateAsync
recipient.delegateRecipient.signature: Task DelegateAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, DelegateRecipientRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.delegateRecipient.summary: Delegates the recipient's signing responsibility to someone else. The envelope sender must have enabled delegation, and only the recipient may call this (a signing session). The original role is renamed to record the delegation and a new recipient with the same role name, order, and sequence is added; unless no_contact is set, the new recipient and the creator are notified.

returns.description: A task that completes when the delegation is recorded. The server responds with a status body that carries nothing.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because delegation is not enabled.

recipient.updateRecipient.name: UpdateAsync
recipient.updateRecipient.signature: Task<Recipient> UpdateAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, UpdateRecipientParams request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.updateRecipient.summary: Updates a recipient: contact details, invite message, auth prefills, or a remind/reset action. Rate-limit this in user interfaces to avoid spamming recipients; excessive use may lead Verdocs to rate-limit the calling application. Returns 200 OK even when the envelope's no_contact flag silently suppresses the resulting notification.

params.name: request
params.description: The fields to change; unset fields are left alone.

returns.description: The updated recipient.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller is not the creator.

recipient.remindRecipient.name: RemindAsync
recipient.remindRecipient.signature: Task RemindAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.remindRecipient.summary: Sends a reminder to a recipient. The recipient must still be an active member of the signing flow (not declined or already submitted).

returns.description: A task that completes when the reminder is queued. The server responds with a status body that carries nothing.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the recipient already submitted.

recipient.resetRecipient.name: ResetAsync
recipient.resetRecipient.signature: Task ResetAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.resetRecipient.summary: Fully resets a recipient, letting them restart failed KBA flows or redo fields they filled in incorrectly. Cannot be used on a canceled or completed envelope, but may restart a declined one.

returns.description: A task that completes when the reset is recorded. The server responds with a status body that carries nothing.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the envelope is complete.

recipient.askQuestion.name: AskQuestionAsync
recipient.askQuestion.signature: Task<Recipient> AskQuestionAsync(string envelopeId, string roleName, string question, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
recipient.askQuestion.summary: Asks the sender a question. Emails the envelope's sender (via sender_email, if set at creation) with the recipient's information and their question; replying is up to the sender. Called by recipients during signing.

returns.description: The recipient, as the server echoes it back.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

signature.createSignature.name: CreateAsync
signature.createSignature.signature: Task<Signature> CreateAsync(Stream content, string fileName, string? contentType = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
signature.createSignature.summary: Creates a signature block from an image. Signers typically adopt one signature block at the start of signing, then reuse its ID for every signature field to be stamped (via the envelope field update). Accepts a user or a signing session: guest signers get an auto-created profile and typically hold one block tied to that session, while authenticated users can keep several and use them interchangeably. The stored image is not fetchable through the v2 API; the block's ID is what matters.

params.name: fileName
params.description: The filename to store with the image.

params.name: contentType
params.description: The image's MIME type. Defaults to application/octet-stream; the server stores the declared type without validating it.

returns.description: The newly created signature block.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.

templateDocument.createTemplateDocument.name: CreateAsync
templateDocument.createTemplateDocument.signature: Task<TemplateDocument> CreateAsync(string templateId, TemplateFileUpload file, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.createTemplateDocument.summary: Attaches a document to a template. The upload is multipart: one file part named "file" plus the template ID as a text part. The document takes its name from the uploaded file name; there is no name override. PDF and DOCX are accepted (DOCX is converted to PDF server-side, with the original retained), up to 25 MB.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template to attach the document to.

returns.description: The new template document.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the file was an unsupported type.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocument.name: GetAsync
templateDocument.getTemplateDocument.signature: Task<TemplateDocument> GetAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.getTemplateDocument.summary: Gets a template document's metadata. Non-creators (organization collaborators, for example) receive only the metadata they are allowed to view. The server sends this JSON with a text/html content type; the SDK parses the body as JSON regardless.

returns.description: The document's metadata.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the document was not found.

templateDocument.downloadTemplateDocumen.name: DownloadAsync
templateDocument.downloadTemplateDocumen.signature: Task<byte[]> DownloadAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.downloadTemplateDocumen.summary: Downloads a template document's file directly. Returns the raw bytes with no redirect; use this rather than a plain link so the authorization headers are set.

returns.description: The file's raw bytes.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the document was not found.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentDown.name: GetDownloadLinkAsync
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentDown.signature: Task<string> GetDownloadLinkAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentDown.summary: Gets a pre-signed download link for a template document (attachment disposition, about a one hour expiry). The link needs no auth header, so use it immediately and never share it.

returns.description: The signed URL, as a bare string.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the document was not found.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPrev.name: GetPreviewLinkAsync
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPrev.signature: Task<string> GetPreviewLinkAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPrev.summary: Gets a pre-signed preview link (inline disposition). Anomaly preserved from the js-sdk: this fetches the envelope-documents route, not template-documents, so it only resolves for envelope document IDs. The template-documents equivalent is GET /v2/template-documents/:id?type=preview, which this SDK does not wrap yet.

params.name: documentId
params.description: The document ID to link to.

returns.description: The signed URL, as a bare string.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the document was not found.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentFile.name: GetFileAsync
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentFile.signature: Task<byte[]> GetFileAsync(string templateId, string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentFile.summary: Gets a template document file through the legacy templates route. Dead on the deployed API: the route does not exist, so every call fails. Ported to match the js-sdk surface; DownloadAsync is the working equivalent. Retirement is pending.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template the document belongs to.

returns.description: The file's raw bytes, if the API ever serves this route.

throws.description: Always thrown today; the deployed API has no handler for this call.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentThum.name: GetThumbnailAsync
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentThum.signature: Task<byte[]> GetThumbnailAsync(string templateId, string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentThum.summary: Gets a template document thumbnail through the legacy templates route. Dead on the deployed API: the route does not exist, so every call fails. Ported to match the js-sdk surface; the working way to get a thumbnail is the page-image route with the literal page value "thumb", which this SDK does not wrap yet (GetPageDisplayUriAsync takes numeric pages, matching the js-sdk). Retirement is pending.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template the document belongs to.

returns.description: The thumbnail's raw bytes, if the API ever serves this route.

throws.description: Always thrown today; the deployed API has no handler for this call.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPage.name: GetPageDisplayUriAsync
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPage.signature: Task<string> GetPageDisplayUriAsync(string documentId, int page, string variant = original, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPage.summary: Gets a display URI for one page of a template document. Pages are rendered server-side to PNG for display only; they are not legally binding and carry no participant metadata. Get the original file via DownloadAsync.

returns.description: The signed URL, as a bare string.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the document was not found.

templateDocument.deleteTemplateDocument.name: DeleteAsync
templateDocument.deleteTemplateDocument.signature: Task<Template> DeleteAsync(string documentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
templateDocument.deleteTemplateDocument.summary: Deletes a template document. Returns the remaining deep template: the js-sdk doc tag claims a bare status string, but its code and the server both return the template.

returns.description: The template the document was removed from, with its remaining documents, roles, and fields.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the caller may not edit the template.

field.createField.name: CreateAsync
field.createField.signature: Task<TemplateField> CreateAsync(string templateId, CreateFieldRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
field.createField.summary: Adds a field to a template. Note that Y positions are measured bottom to top.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template to add the field to.

returns.description: The new field.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the role name does not exist.

field.updateField.name: UpdateAsync
field.updateField.signature: Task<TemplateField> UpdateAsync(string templateId, string fieldName, UpdateFieldRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
field.updateField.summary: Updates a field. Unset request properties leave the stored values unchanged.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template the field belongs to.

returns.description: The updated field.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a new name is already in use.

field.deleteField.name: DeleteAsync
field.deleteField.signature: Task DeleteAsync(string templateId, string fieldName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
field.deleteField.summary: Removes a field from a template.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template the field belongs to.

returns.description: A task that completes when the field has been deleted.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the field was not found.

role.createTemplateRole.name: CreateAsync
role.createTemplateRole.signature: Task<Role> CreateAsync(string templateId, CreateRoleRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
role.createTemplateRole.summary: Adds a role to a template.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template to add the role to.

returns.description: The new role.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the role name is already in use.

role.updateTemplateRole.name: UpdateAsync
role.updateTemplateRole.signature: Task<Role> UpdateAsync(string templateId, string roleName, UpdateRoleRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
role.updateTemplateRole.summary: Updates a role. Unset request properties leave the stored values unchanged.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template the role belongs to.

returns.description: The updated role.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because a new name is already in use.

role.deleteTemplateRole.name: DeleteAsync
role.deleteTemplateRole.signature: Task DeleteAsync(string templateId, string roleName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

params.name: templateId
params.description: The template the role belongs to.

returns.description: A task that completes when the role has been deleted.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the role was not found.

webhook.getWebhooks.name: GetAsync
webhook.getWebhooks.summary: Gets the webhook configuration for the caller's organization. The server answers 404 when no configuration has ever been set. The client secret and signing secret are masked to their last four characters in this response.

returns.description: The organization's webhook configuration.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because nothing is configured yet.

webhook.setWebhooks.name: SetAsync
webhook.setWebhooks.signature: Task<Webhook> SetAsync(SetWebhookRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
webhook.setWebhooks.summary: Sets the webhook configuration for the caller's organization. Configurations cannot be deleted; disable deliveries by setting Active to false or the URL to an empty string.

returns.description: The updated webhook configuration.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the URL is not HTTPS.

webhook.rotateWebhookSecret.name: RotateSecretAsync
webhook.rotateWebhookSecret.summary: Rotates (or first creates) the secret used to sign webhook deliveries. Until a secret exists, deliveries carry no signature header. Deliveries already queued keep the old signature; new events use the new secret. To authenticate a delivery, compare an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the payload's inner "body" field against the x-webhook-signature request header.

returns.description: The webhook configuration including the new, unmasked secret key.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because nothing is configured yet.

color.getRGB.name: GetRgb
color.getRGB.summary: Converts an "rgba(r,g,b,a)" string to its hex equivalent, dropping alpha. The alpha channel is composited against white first, so the hex color is what the translucent tint actually looks like on a page.

returns.description: The lowercase hex color, e.g. "#ffe69c".

color.getRGBA.name: GetRgba
color.getRGBA.summary: Returns the color code for a signer given its role index. Indexes cycle through ten colors; index 0 gets its own shade so the first signer stands out from every tenth one after it.

params.name: roleIndex
params.description: Zero-based index of the role in the template's role list.

returns.description: A CSS rgba() string.

color.nameToRGBA.name: NameToRgba
color.nameToRGBA.summary: Derives a stable color code from a role name. The color is not specified explicitly: a hash of the name picks it, so the same name always yields the same color. Matches the js-sdk hash (including its 32-bit shift wraparound) so every SDK tints a given role identically.

params.name: name
params.description:
The role name. Names ending in a digit get extra hash input so "Signer 1" and
            "Signer 2" land on visibly different colors.

returns.description: A CSS rgba() string, or null for an empty name (the js-sdk returns undefined there).

color.getRoleColor.name: GetRoleColor
color.getRoleColor.signature: string? GetRoleColor(string? name, IReadOnlyList<string>? roles, int? index = null)
color.getRoleColor.summary: Picks a color code for a role name from whichever inputs are available. An explicit index wins, then the name's position in the roles list, and a name absent from the list falls back to the name hash.

params.name: roles
params.description: The template's role names, in order. May be null or empty.

params.name: index
params.description:
Explicit role index. The js-sdk checks truthiness, so 0 falls through to the roles
            lookup; we keep that quirk.

returns.description: A CSS rgba() string, or null when only an empty name is available.

dateTime.formatShortTimeAgo.name: FormatShortTimeAgo
dateTime.formatShortTimeAgo.summary: Formats how long ago a moment was as a compact unit string, e.g. "5M". Units are S, M (minutes), H, D, W, and Y, matching the js-sdk output byte for byte.

params.name: value
params.description: The moment to describe; null yields "".

returns.description:
The elapsed time as "<n><unit>", or "" when there is nothing to format. A
            future moment comes out with a negative count, as in the js-sdk.

entitlement.collapseEntitlements.name: CollapseEntitlements
entitlement.collapseEntitlements.summary: Collapses raw entitlement records down to the active one per feature. Only entries whose date window covers now survive, and the first record per feature wins, so presence of a key means the feature is currently enabled. This is the client-side twin of what GetActiveEntitlementsAsync returns.

params.name: entitlements
params.description: The raw records, e.g. from GetEntitlementsAsync.

returns.description: Feature name (see EntitlementFeature) to the entitlement record currently granting it.

fieldUtil.getRTop.name: GetRTop
fieldUtil.getRTop.signature: double GetRTop(double y, double fieldHeight, double iTextHeight, double yRatio)
fieldUtil.getRTop.summary: Returns the rendered top offset for a field. Flips the y axis: PDF y grows upward from the page bottom, screen y grows downward from the top.

params.name: y
params.description: The field's PDF y position (bottom edge).

params.name: fieldHeight
params.description: The field's height in document units.

params.name: iTextHeight
params.description: The rendered page height in pixels.

params.name: yRatio
params.description: Pixels per document unit on the y axis.

returns.description: The top offset in pixels.

fieldUtil.getRLeft.name: GetRLeft
fieldUtil.getRLeft.summary: Returns the rendered left offset for a field: its PDF x scaled to pixels.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Pixels per document unit on the x axis.

returns.description: The left offset in pixels.

fieldUtil.getRValue.name: GetRValue
fieldUtil.getRValue.summary: Returns a document-space value scaled to rendered pixels.

returns.description: The value in pixels.

fieldUtil.rescale.name: Rescale
fieldUtil.rescale.summary: Returns a value scaled by a ratio.

returns.description: The scaled value.

fieldUtil.blobToBase64.name: BytesToBase64
fieldUtil.blobToBase64.summary: Encodes raw bytes as a base64 string. Adapted from the js-sdk's blobToBase64, which reads a browser Blob through FileReader and resolves a data URL. A byte array carries no MIME type, so this returns the bare base64 payload; use BytesToDataUrl when the "data:<type>;base64," prefix is needed.

returns.description: The base64-encoded string.

file.fileToDataUrl.name: BytesToDataUrl
file.fileToDataUrl.summary: Encodes bytes as a base64 data URL with the given MIME type, e.g. "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0K...". Adapted from the js-sdk's fileToDataUrl; that helper returns the browser File's metadata alongside the data URL, but a byte array has no metadata, so this returns the data URL string directly.

params.name: contentType
params.description: The MIME type to embed, e.g. "application/pdf".

returns.description: The "data:<type>;base64,<payload>" string.

locale.getCountryByCode.name: GetCountryByCode
locale.getCountryByCode.summary: Finds the country for a display code, e.g. "+44". Falls back to prefix matching for the French overseas territories whose codes are stored with extra digits. Codes shared by several countries return the first table entry ("+1" returns American Samoa, never the United States); use GetPlusOneCountry to tell NANP territories apart.

params.name: code
params.description: The display code to look up.

returns.description: The matching country, or null.

locale.isFrenchGuiana.name: IsFrenchGuiana
locale.isFrenchGuiana.summary: Whether the code starts with French Guiana's +594 prefix.

returns.description: True when the prefix matches.

locale.isGuadeloupe.name: IsGuadeloupe
locale.isGuadeloupe.summary: Whether the code starts with Guadeloupe's +590 prefix.

returns.description: True when the prefix matches.

locale.isMartinique.name: IsMartinique
locale.isMartinique.summary: Whether the code starts with Martinique's +596 prefix.

returns.description: True when the prefix matches.

locale.isMayotte.name: IsMayotte
locale.isMayotte.summary: Whether the code starts with the Mayotte/Reunion +262 prefix.

returns.description: True when the prefix matches.

locale.getPlusOneCountry.name: GetPlusOneCountry
locale.getPlusOneCountry.summary: Resolves a "+1" NANP code to its territory by area-code prefix. The first five characters decide the match, so the literal "+1" (nothing after it) yields a country with an empty name, as in the js-sdk switch.

returns.description: The matching country, or null for unrecognized prefixes.

locale.isCanada.name: IsCanada
locale.isCanada.summary: Whether a "+1" code carries a Canadian area code.

returns.description: True when the area code is Canadian.

locale.isAmericanSamoa.name: IsAmericanSamoa
locale.isAmericanSamoa.summary: Whether the code starts with American Samoa's +1684 prefix.

returns.description: True when the prefix matches.

locale.isDominicanRepublic.name: IsDominicanRepublic
locale.isDominicanRepublic.summary: Whether the code starts with a Dominican Republic prefix (+1809/+1829/+1849).

returns.description: True when the prefix matches.

locale.isPuertoRico.name: IsPuertoRico
locale.isPuertoRico.summary: Whether the code is Puerto Rico's. Ported js-sdk bug: the js compares against "+" twice where the real prefixes are +1787 and +1939, so this returns true only for the literal string "+". Kept as-is per the true-up policy of porting quirks rather than fixing them.

returns.description: True only for the literal string "+".

locale.getMatchingCountry.name: GetMatchingCountry
locale.getMatchingCountry.summary: Counts the table entries whose code equals the first characters of the input. The js-sdk marks this one "need to finish": despite the name it returns a count, not a country, and duplicate rows count twice. Ported as-is.

params.name: substrings
params.description: How many leading characters to compare (negative counts as zero, like the JS substring bound).

returns.description: How many Countries rows carry exactly that code prefix.

primitive.integerSequence.name: IntegerSequence
primitive.integerSequence.summary: Returns a list of consecutive integers, e.g. [start, start + 1, ...]. Frequently useful in rendering when there is no source list to iterate.

returns.description: A list of  integers beginning at .

primitive.formatFullName.name: FormatFullName
primitive.formatFullName.summary: Formats a profile-like record's full name, capitalized. The js-sdk takes a structural source object; pass the record's name fields directly, e.g. FormatFullName(profile.FirstName, profile.LastName).

params.name: firstName
params.description: The first name; null is treated as empty.

params.name: lastName
params.description: The last name; null is treated as empty.

returns.description:
"First Last", trimmed, so a single known name comes back alone and no names at all
            come back as "".

primitive.formatInitials.name: FormatInitials
primitive.formatInitials.summary: Formats a profile's initials, e.g. "T U", with "--" for no profile.

params.name: profile
params.description:
The profile to read. The js-sdk assumes both names are present; a missing one is
            treated as empty here rather than throwing.

returns.description: The space-separated uppercase initials, or "--" when there is no profile to read.

primitive.fullNameToInitials.name: FullNameToInitials
primitive.fullNameToInitials.summary: Generates suggested initials for a full name, e.g. "John Doe" yields "JD". Splits on single spaces and keeps each word's first character unchanged, matching the js-sdk (which does not uppercase here).

returns.description: The concatenated first characters.

string.capitalize.name: Capitalize
string.capitalize.summary: Returns the string with its first letter uppercased.

params.name: value
params.description: The string to capitalize. May be empty.

returns.description: The input with the first character uppercased, other characters untouched.

string.convertToE164.name: ConvertToE164
string.convertToE164.summary: Converts a phone-number-like string to E.164 format, assuming US numbers. A value already prefixed with "+" is only trimmed: the caller set a country code deliberately, so non-US numbers pass through untouched. Everything else has punctuation stripped, one leading zero removed, and "+1" prepended (the js-sdk assumes US for unprefixed input, and we keep that).

params.name: input
params.description: The phone-number-like input; null is treated as empty.

returns.description: The E.164 string, or the trimmed input when it was blank or "+"-prefixed.

string.randomString.name: RandomString
string.randomString.summary: Generates a random lowercase-alphanumeric string of the given length. Adapted from the js-sdk, which slices Math.random().toString(36) and, due to an off-by-one in its substring bounds, actually returns length + 1 characters. We draw exactly characters from the same base36 alphabet using a cryptographic RNG (per the true-up handoff), so the output is also safe for more than DOM-id duty.

returns.description: A random string of exactly  characters from [0-9a-z].

token.decodeJWTBody.name: DecodeJwtBody
token.decodeJWTBody.summary: Decodes the payload segment of a JWT without verifying the signature. Lets callers read claims (expiry, IDs, session type) without a JWT dependency. Only real JWTs work; opaque tokens throw, mirroring the js-sdk's throw. Use DecodeAccessTokenBody for the non-throwing form.

params.name: token
params.description: The JWT; null is treated as empty.

returns.description: The parsed payload, whatever JSON it holds.

throws.description: The payload segment is not valid base64 or base64url.
The payload segment does not decode to JSON.

token.decodeAccessTokenBody.name: DecodeAccessTokenBody
token.decodeAccessTokenBody.summary: Decodes a Verdocs access token's claims, returning null for anything malformed. User and signing sessions have different claim sets; tell them apart by SessionType or by the claims only one carries (EnvelopeId appears only on signing tokens). SetToken runs this same decode when it stores a token; this helper hands back the claims for callers inspecting a token directly, without checking expiry.

params.name: token
params.description: The access token; null is treated as empty.

returns.description:
The decoded session, or null. Stricter than the js-sdk: the token must have three
            segments, an object payload, and a user or signing session_type claim, where js
            accepts any segment count and any JSON type.
